orgName: Saudi Super Cup 2026 (Saudi Arabian Football Federation)

source.name: Goal.com - Officially: a Gulf state to host the Saudi Super Cup
source.note: SAFF announced on 14 September 2026 that the 2026 edition will be held in Kuwait, 19-23 December, at Jaber Al-Ahmad International Stadium; Kuwait is the competition's eighth venue; draw expected 14 October.

note: One-off host for the 2026 edition; the article gives no contract term or fee. The competition is organised by the Saudi Arabian Football Federation; its clubs include PIF-owned (Al-Nassr, Al-Ahli) and Aramco-owned (Al-Qadsiah) teams - see saudi-pro-league.
